meta.userDecision: Use nearest station proxy when no direct subdistrict station exists; proxy must be labelled with distance, freshness and confidence.
meta.noFabricationRule: Do not create rainfall_mm, affected rai, farmer count, or risk scores where source access does not support the value.

outcome.rain24SubdistrictJoinPolicy: Do not join station readings to subdistrict coverage by Thai names. Use station/admin code crosswalk only.
